<strong>Come funziona.</strong> EVIL non: How it works. EVIL does not access profiles and does not collect private content: it queries public APIs and checks whether a page responds. Social networks' HTTP responses are only indicative: always confirm by opening the link.
<strong>Regole.</strong> Usa lo strument: Rules. Use the tool on your own accounts or with the written consent of the person concerned. Collecting and cross-referencing other people's profiles without a legal basis (Art. 6 GDPR) and without informing them (Art. 14 GDPR) is forbidden, as is doxxing. See Privacy and terms.
